method: Compare frozen source-file dates with NASA structured UTC outage intervals. A gap overlaps a UTC day when its start precedes next midnight and its end follows that day’s midnight; intervals are half-open. Required masks are the first two of each four-day window; target is the fourth day.
scope: All 250 metadata-selected events before input eligibility filtering; counts are not counts of model-eligible events.
limitations: Metadata-only diagnostic; no TIFF pixel values or target labels were read.
The frozen primary sample, model selection, release gate and eligibility are unchanged. No outcome-dependent removal is performed.
NASA lists major known outages. Geographic impact and complete local overpass/cloud coverage are unknown; absence of a listed gap does not establish a fully observed day.
The current catalogue is retrospective. This audit does not establish that an outage was published or known at historical issue time.
Input-gap flags describe where the current conservative live abstention rule would apply given this catalogue. Target gaps may affect the recorded detection label and are not future inputs.
